notes.title: Garden of Wandering Souls Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, welcome to Devlog vol. 2 for Garden of Wandering Souls. In this article, we will discuss some of the development progress of our games, including a new stage, Steam Page Improvement, and an event we attended last month, the G2G Fest.

[h2]New Stage[/h2]
The Garden is a vast landscape with various terrains, a place for souls waiting for their next phase of the afterlife.  In the last couple of months, in the promotional screenshots and videos, we only show the first stage of the game, one of the garden biome, a mostly greyish dark gloomy place to show the loneliness of the afterlife.

After a couple of iterations, we are ready to introduce a new biome that acts as the second stage of GWS. Welcome to the desert area of the garden, a dry, hot, and harsh land where some souls end up lost. In this area, we’re changing the visuals and adding difficulty by adding new types of souls, bosses, various new towers, and new mechanics to make the game more fun and challenging!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119726/6c45f80113b0acc22ee70323d2ccc74bc6559791.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Page Improvements[/h2]
If you read this, you probably will notice, that our Steam page has already changed. Our key art and capsule now emphasize more gameplay to show Steam users the core of our gameplay rather than cryptic artwork from before. Also, we added title art and gifs to the description! What do you guys think about the new look?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119726/39141e7d22e267b117367c9930a3b9936f9cbfc8.png[/img]

[h2]G2G Fest[/h2]
Last month, we attended and opened a demo booth at Gamers to Gamers Festival Chapter 3 in Jakarta. Gamers to Gamers Fest is the biggest gamer festival in Indonesia, managed by The Lazy Monday, Indonesia Gaming Media, and friends of Arsanesia. It is the second time we have showcased Garden of Wandering Souls at an offline expo; this time, it is the most crowded.

Many people queued and tried our demo, it was a blast!  We’re happy a lot of people can finally try (modified version of) our game. Yes, due to the limitation of offline events (queue and time), we modified the game to accommodate more general visitors by reducing the waves and difficulty. Because of this event, we’re able to notice so many player's behaviors in real-time, which help us not to improve the game blindly.
Thank you to all gamers who try our games at G2G!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119726/d21c77dd666ed43ade390563b40de7907e1e8a04.png[/img]

Lastly, we want to thank YOU for reading this devlog! Wish us luck so we can develop a game that can exceed your expectations! Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Garden of Wandering Souls Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hi guardian of The Garden! Welcome to our first Devlog series. We’ve got some exciting updates to bring you up to speed on our progress!

[h1]Release of Our First Gameplay Trailer[/h1]
We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve just released our first gameplay trailer! This trailer was created in collaboration with The Lazy Monday, a well-known gaming media channel on YouTube from Indonesia. It’s designed to give you a better understanding of the game’s mechanics and overall vibe. We’d love to hear your thoughts, was it easy to follow? Did it capture the essence of the game? Your feedback is invaluable, so let us know what you think!
Check it out here: 

[previewyoutube=rF7jLa7tYzY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Public Playtest at Indonesia Game Expo (IGX)
[/h1]
We recently showcased our game for the first time at IGX, and it was an incredible experience! This was our debut public playtest, and seeing the response firsthand was both thrilling and motivating. Around 200 passionate gamers stopped by to try out the game, and their reactions were overwhelmingly positive. What made the event even more special was the opportunity to engage directly with the community and gather immediate feedback. Getting real-time notes on what works and what needs a bit more polish is invaluable for us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119726/90e9346f9e43d841f9a56cb1eb715d19f98d996a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Closed Beta Testing
[/h1]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GadteUhboAA2qBK?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
We’re also opening up a closed beta for those who are eager to dive in early and share their insights. If you’re interested, make sure to fill out the form below. Invitations have already been sent out to our first wave of testers, and we’ll be inviting more players regularly. Don’t miss out—sign up now and keep an eye on your inbox!
link: [url=https://bit.ly/gws-playtest]https://bit.ly/gws-playtest [/url]

[h1]Updates Based on The Community's Feedback
[/h1]
Thanks to your input, we’ve been refining and enhancing the game. Here are a few key updates we’ve made:
[list]
[*] [b]Content Balance[/b]: The gameplay is now more balanced, so we’re moving forward with developing new stages to keep things fresh.
[*] [b]Projectile vs. No Projectile[/b]: We’ve made improvements in response to discussions about shooting vs absorbing mechanics. Now we're implementing projectiles to add more clarity and impact.
[/list]

After implementing more updates based on the feedback from our IGX playtest and the first wave of closed beta testing, we’ll continue testing and iterating. Our goal is to prepare a build ready for open beta testing. Make sure to follow our Steam page for the latest updates and announcements!
Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your feedback and support mean everything!

notes.notes:

Did you know, that August 8th is celebrated as Indonesian Games Day in Indonesia?

Generally speaking, as a country, Indonesia is pretty new in terms of the history of game development. But in a short time, many of us have already produced many high-quality titles that gamers worldwide enjoy! AGI (Indonesian Game Association) with several developers including Arsanesia is collaborating to create a special Steam page for this event from August 8th - 31st to celebrate the industry. You can check many great games made by Indonesian developers, wishlists, and even purchase!

Check them out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/HARGAI2024]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/HARGAI2024[/url]

notes.title: Garden of Wandering Souls Steam Page is HERE!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to reveal our upcoming game, [b]Garden of Wandering Souls[/b]! Play as a Charon, the guide for the wandering souls in the Astarum, a place where departed souls linger before reaching their next destination, in a tower defense game with rogue-lite elements where you strategize using a random set of cards and tiles to prevent lost souls from becoming truly lost

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]Multiple Tactical Choices[/h3]
Plan your resources well and strategize your defense with numerous available towers (Pyxs). While luck plays a part, in the end, your skill affects the results. Each stage can be approached in various ways, so look for the most effective one!
[h3]Thrilling Challenge with Roguelite Element[/h3]
With randomly generated maps, each playthrough will feel like a brand-new game. Permadeath with progression adds more tension and excitement in every wave.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list][*][b]Be the Compass for the Souls:[/b] As Charon, deploy Pyxs to draw in and shepherd lost souls, helping them find their way.
[*][b]Maze-like Garden that Changes Frequently:[/b] Experience unique and unpredictable challenges with procedurally generated maps, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same.
[*][b]Guide the Vengeful Souls:[/b] Some souls will test your strategic and adaptability skills as they are tougher to guide than others.
[*][b]Plan and Adapt Your Path and Pyxs:[/b] Plan your defense with a wide variety of towers (Pyxs), drawing from a deck of random cards.
[*][b]Keep Your Hand:[/b] You can save your card for later use, giving you greater control over your strategy.
[*][b]Failing is Not the End:[/b] Enjoy the excitement of permadeath combined with a rewarding progression system. Unlock new towers, abilities, and upgrades as you master the game.
[*][b]Multiple Game Mode: [/b]After completing the main story, challenge yourself further with the Daily Challenge Mode.[/list]
